name: parental-web
description: Build-time only: strips comments from the served files, compiles Tailwind v4 + daisyUI into assets/app.css, and runs the tests for assets/*.js. Nothing here ships in the .exe.

scripts.build: node scripts/strip-comments.mjs && tailwindcss -i src/app.css -o ../assets/app.css --minify && node scripts/stamp-build.mjs
